sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meta_entries" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sex" TEXT NOT NULL, "age_years" INTEGER NOT NULL, "height_cm" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "measured_resting_hr" INTEGER NULL, "death_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "rng_seed" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "died_at" TEXT NULL, "death_cause" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vitals" ("profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_update" TEXT NOT NULL, "blood_ml" REAL NOT NULL, "water_ml" REAL NOT NULL, "calories_kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "heart_rate_bpm" REAL NOT NULL, "sleep_debt_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "zone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, "accuracy_m" REAL NULL, "rng_cursors" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "bleed_tier" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "down_until" TEXT NULL, "grace_until" TEXT NULL, "hunt_until" TEXT NULL, "hunt_latitude" REAL NULL, "hunt_longitude" REAL NULL, "hunt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "occupation_json" TEXT NULL, "speed_kmh" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "carried_kg" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "pending_kcal" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "pending_water_ml" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "dry_streak_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "starved_streak_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "body_mass_kg" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "sleep_strain" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, PRIMARY KEY ("profile_id"), FOREIGN KEY (profile_id) REFERENCES profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chronicle_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "survival_days" INTEGER NOT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "ended_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "cause" TEXT NOT NULL, "death_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "snapshot_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', FOREIGN KEY (profile_id) REFERENCES profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "snapshot_records" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "taken_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "checksum" TEXT NOT NULL, "schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'periodic');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inventory_lines" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "slot" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pack', "condition" REAL NULL, "pages_total" INTEGER NULL, "pages_read" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "note_id" TEXT NULL, "portion" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, "attachments" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "rounds" INTEGER NULL, "salvage_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "uid" TEXT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (profile_id) REFERENCES profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "loot_boxes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "poi_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "latitude" REAL NOT NULL, "longitude" REAL NOT NULL, "table_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "spawned_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "looted_at" TEXT NULL, "respawn_at" TEXT NULL, "opened_at" TEXT NULL, "search_units" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, FOREIGN KEY (profile_id) REFERENCES profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, UNIQUE (profile_id, poi_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ground_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "condition" REAL NULL, "pages_total" INTEGER NULL, "pages_read" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "attachments" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "rounds" INTEGER NULL, "latitude" REAL NOT NULL, "longitude" REAL NOT NULL, "dropped_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "salvage_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "uid" TEXT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (profile_id) REFERENCES profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shelters" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "latitude" REAL NOT NULL, "longitude" REAL NOT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "build_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "build_left_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "worked_at" TEXT NULL, "modules" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "visited_at" TEXT NULL, "building" TEXT NULL, "building_ready_at" TEXT NULL, "building_left_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "paused" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("paused" IN (0, 1)), FOREIGN KEY (profile_id) REFERENCES profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "remains_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "enemy_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "latitude" REAL NOT NULL, "longitude" REAL NOT NULL, "died_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "searched" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("searched" IN (0, 1)), FOREIGN KEY (profile_id) REFERENCES profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, UNIQUE (profile_id, enemy_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profile_stats" ("profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "shots_fired" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "shots_hit" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "swings" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "swings_hit" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "hits_head" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "hits_torso" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "hits_arms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "hits_legs" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "kills" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "blood_dealt_ml" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "blood_lost_ml" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "searches" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "blackouts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("profile_id"), FOREIGN KEY (profile_id) REFERENCES profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shelter_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "shelter_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "condition" REAL NULL, "pages_total" INTEGER NULL, "pages_read" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "note_id" TEXT NULL, "portion" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, "attachments" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "rounds" INTEGER NULL, "salvage_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "uid" TEXT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (profile_id) REFERENCES profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (shelter_id) REFERENCES shelters (id) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "craft_jobs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "recipe_id" TEXT NULL, "salvage_item_id" TEXT NULL, "salvage_condition" REAL NULL, "salvage_batch" TEXT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "ready_at" TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (profile_id) REFERENCES profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "active_actions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject_uid" TEXT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "total_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "credited_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, "extra_json" TEXT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (profile_id) REFERENCES profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "skills" ("profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "skill" TEXT NOT NULL, "xp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("profile_id", "skill"), FOREIGN KEY (profile_id) REFERENCES profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "hotspots" ("profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "slot" INTEGER NOT NULL, "seed" INTEGER NOT NULL, "latitude" REAL NOT NULL, "longitude" REAL NOT NULL, "level" INTEGER NOT NULL, "integrity" REAL NOT NULL, "born_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "next_level_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "surged_at" TEXT NULL, "agitated_until" TEXT NULL, "resting_until" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("profile_id", "slot"), FOREIGN KEY (profile_id) REFERENCES profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "journal" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "at" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject" TEXT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (profile_id) REFERENCES profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "read_titles" ("profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "copies" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("profile_id", "item_id"), FOREIGN KEY (profile_id) REFERENCES profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "play_days" ("profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "active_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("profile_id", "day"), FOREIGN KEY (profile_id) REFERENCES profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE);
